orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.desc: Groups of domains that share one address book, one LDAP directory and one set of organization administrators.
orgs.addDesc: Attach domains to it from the organization's page once it exists.
orgs.name: Name

orgDetail.detailsDesc: The name every administrator of this organization sees.
orgDetail.domainsDesc: One LDAP directory serves every domain in an organization; a domain that needs a different directory belongs in its own organization.
orgDetail.deleteDesc: Its domains become organizationless, and its LDAP config, sync policy and org-admin grants are removed.
orgDetail.confirmDelete: Delete {0}? Its domains become organizationless and its LDAP config, sync policy, and org-admin grants are removed.

domains.title: Domains
domains.desc: The mail domains this server accepts mail for, and the organization each belongs to.
domains.addDesc: Publish its DNS records from the domain's page once it exists.
domains.name: Domain name
domains.confirmPurge: Purge {0}? This permanently removes the domain and every user, alias, and list in it.
domains.defaultsUnread: Could not read the create defaults. The form is hidden so a new domain does not skip them.
domains.limitFailed: Created the domain, but could not set the user limit.

domainDetail.detailsDesc: Status, organization, mailbox limit and the contact details of this domain.
domainDetail.title: Title
domainDetail.publicFoldersDesc: Folders every user of this domain shares.
domainDetail.contactsDesc: External addresses listed in this domain's address book.
domainDetail.groupsDesc: Mailing lists and groups in this domain.
domainDetail.spamDesc: Inbound mail at or above this score goes to Junk for this domain's mailboxes, unless a user sets their own. Empty inherits the global threshold; an operator block or allow rule still wins.
domainDetail.avDesc: Scan this domain's mail through ClamAV. A match is quarantined, not delivered, and the recipient plus the domain and organization administrators are notified.
domainDetail.avHint: Inbound covers messages arriving for this domain's mailboxes; outbound covers messages its users send. Scanning also requires a clamd service configured on the server.
domainDetail.catchAllDesc: Mail addressed to a local part this domain does not have is delivered to this mailbox instead of being refused.
domainDetail.catchAllHint: It applies to delivery only: an unknown address still cannot sign in, and it appears in no address book. The delivered message carries a Delivered-To header naming the address it was sent to.
domainDetail.splitDesc: Share this domain with another mail system. Leave the host empty when every address of the domain lives here.
domainDetail.splitHint: Mail that local users send, and mail this server generates, to an address of this domain with no mailbox here is delivered to this host instead of being refused. Mail arriving from outside for such an address is still refused, and postmaster stays local.
domainDetail.gatewayDesc: Mail whose sender is in this domain is handed to this server instead of the global gateway. Leave it unset to follow the global setting.
domainDetail.senderNameDesc: Rebuild the From display name on outgoing mail from the sender's profile.
domainDetail.senderNameHint: Leave a template blank to keep the sender's own From name for that direction.
domainDetail.dkimDesc: Signs outbound mail from this domain so it passes DKIM and DMARC at receivers.
domainDetail.dkimHint: Generate a key, publish the DNS record it shows, allow a few minutes for it to propagate, then enable signing. Enabling before the record is published and visible makes your mail fail DKIM.
domainDetail.dnsDesc: Publish these records at the domain owner's DNS provider so mail routes to this server and passes SPF, DKIM and DMARC.
domainDetail.name: Name
domainDetail.healthDesc: Resolves this domain's live mail-related DNS records (read-only). Run it after publishing the records above.
domainDetail.policyDesc: Overrides the server default for this domain's devices; a per-user override is merged on top. Leave a field unset to inherit. Password rules apply only when DevicePasswordEnabled is Yes.
domainDetail.overrideDesc: Overrides the system create-defaults for new users in this domain. Leave a field on Inherit to use the system value.
domainDetail.brandingDesc: What the login screen shows for users signing in under this domain. Leave all fields blank to inherit the global default.
domainDetail.purgeDesc: Permanently removes the domain and every user, alias and list in it. This cannot be undone.
domainDetail.gatewayOwn: This domain has its own gateway.
domainDetail.gatewayGlobal: This domain follows the global gateway.
domainDetail.confirmRemoveOverride: Remove this domain's gateway? It follows the global gateway again.
domainDetail.usersUnread: Could not read the users of this domain.
domainDetail.contactsUnread: Could not read the contacts of this domain.
domainDetail.groupsUnread: Could not read the groups of this domain.
domainDetail.mtastsUnread: Could not read the MTA-STS settings, so the required records cannot be listed.
domainDetail.dkimUnreadRecords: Could not read the DKIM key, so the required records cannot be listed.
domainDetail.orgFailed: Saved the fields, but the organization change failed.
domainDetail.catchAllFailed: Could not save the catch-all mailbox.
domainDetail.splitHostInvalid: Enter a host name such as mail.example.com.
domainDetail.splitHostSelf: The split host cannot be this server.
domainDetail.splitFailed: Could not save the split domain.
domainDetail.avFailed: Could not save the antivirus toggles.
domainDetail.gatewayUnread: Could not read the stored gateway; nothing was saved.
domainDetail.gatewaySaved: Gateway saved for this domain, the MTA applies it within a minute.
domainDetail.overrideRemoved: Override removed, this domain follows the global gateway again.

dkim.enabled: enabled, outbound mail from this domain is signed
dkim.notSigning: not signing, key generated, publish the record then enable
dkim.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate this domain's DKIM key? Signing stops until you publish the new record and enable it again.
dkim.confirmDelete: Delete this domain's DKIM key? Outbound mail stops being signed.
dkim.noKey: No DKIM key for this domain.
dkim.name: Name:
dkim.unread: Could not read this domain's DKIM key. The key controls are hidden so a generate cannot replace it.
dkim.badSelector: Not a valid selector. Use letters, digits and hyphens, optionally separated by dots.
dkim.badKeyType: Not a supported key type. Choose rsa or ed25519.
dkim.generated: Key generated. Publish the DNS record below, then enable signing.

dnsReport.dkimUnread: Could not read the DKIM key, so the check cannot name its record.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.desc: Extra addresses that deliver to an existing mailbox.
aliases.addDesc: Mail sent to the alias lands in the mailbox it points to.
aliases.required: Both the alias and the target address are required.

mlists.title: Mailing lists
mlists.desc: Addresses that deliver one message to many recipients.
mlists.addDesc: Set its members and owner from the list's page once it exists.

mlistDetail.membersDesc: One address per line. Applies to normal-type lists; a member may itself be a list.
mlistDetail.ownerDesc: The list owner (managedBy); Outlook shows it as the group owner. Leave it empty for none.
mlistDetail.sendersDesc: Used when Who may post is Specified senders. One address or bare domain per line.
mlistDetail.deleteDesc: The list and its members are removed. This cannot be undone.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.desc: External addresses listed in a domain's address book.
contacts.addDesc: The contact appears in the address book of the domain it is filed under.
contacts.required: A contact address and a filing domain are required.
contacts.mastered: This contact is synced from the LDAP directory. Change it there, or turn contact sync off first.

rooms.title: Rooms & Equipment
rooms.desc: Resource mailboxes the calendar room picker offers. A resource cannot sign in; booking it reserves its calendar.
rooms.addDesc: A meeting room or a piece of equipment people book with a meeting.

publicFolders.title: Public folders
publicFolders.desc: Per-domain shared folders. A domain's public folders are enabled the moment its first folder is created.
publicFolders.domainDesc: Pick a domain, create folders, then grant access to anyone in the domain or to a specific user.
publicFolders.createDesc: Nobody can see a new folder until you grant access to it.
publicFolders.folderDesc: Who may open this folder, and at which level.
publicFolders.confirmDelete: Delete public folder {0}? This removes the folder and its messages.
publicFolders.noGrants: No grants yet, nobody can see this folder.
publicFolders.none: No public folders for this domain yet. Create one to enable public folders.
publicFolders.noSuchUser: No such user. Grant to "anyone" or a user's primary address.
publicFolders.otherDomain: Grant a user in this domain, or "anyone".

roles.title: Roles
roles.desc: A role bundles administrative permissions and is assigned to users.
roles.addDesc: Open the role once it exists to choose its permissions and the users who hold it.
roles.name: Name

roleDetail.deleteDesc: Users who hold it lose the permissions it grants.
roleDetail.confirmDelete: Delete role {0}? Users lose the permissions it grants.
roleDetail.detailsDesc: The name administrators see when they assign the role.
roleDetail.orgAdminDesc: Organizations whose domains a holder manages.
roleDetail.domainRODesc: Domains a holder may see but not change.
roleDetail.usersDesc: The users who hold this role.

ldap.title: Directory Sync
ldap.desc: Import accounts, groups and contacts from an LDAP or Active Directory server.
ldap.connectionDesc: Where the directory is and the account this server reads it with.
ldap.fieldsDesc: Enable a field and optionally override the LDAP attribute it reads from.
ldap.aliasDesc: Read each account's additional addresses from the directory.
ldap.aliasHintAfter: prefix is stripped and other schemes are ignored. While the attribute is set the directory OWNS each account's alias set: every sync replaces it, so an alias added here by hand is removed. An address outside your domains, or already in use, is skipped and reported in the sync result.
ldap.groupDesc: Turn directory groups into distribution lists.
ldap.contactDesc: Copy the directory's mail contacts into the address book.
ldap.syncContacts: Sync mail contacts into the address book
ldap.filingHint: A synced contact's own address is external, so it is filed under one of your domains. Contact sync does not run without this.
ldap.syncDesc: Run one sync now with the saved configuration. Save a change first; the sync does not read this form.
ldap.configUnread: Could not read the stored configuration; nothing was saved.
ldap.insecure: Use an ldaps:// URI or enable StartTLS: a plain bind sends every user's password in the clear.
ldap.queued: Directory sync queued as task #{0}, watch the Task queue for its result.
